targets.query:
from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "test_duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"]
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "query_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"],
      _value: 1 - r._value
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(column: "_value", value: 0)
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "active_connections")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${scenario}" == "All" or r["scenario"] == "${scenario}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${scale_factor}" == "All" or (exists r["scale_factor"] and r["scale_factor"] == "${scale_factor}"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"]
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "query_queue_duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${scenario}" == "All" or r["scenario"] == "${scenario}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${scale_factor}" == "All" or (exists r["scale_factor"] and r["scale_factor"] == "${scale_factor}"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"]
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> window(every: 5m)
  |> quantile(q: 0.99, method: "estimate_tdigest")
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

  bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry",
  tag: "scenario",

  start: -30d
)
